back: The middle value of the ordered data: the $\frac{n + 1}{2}$th value.
The most frequent value; for grouped data, the class with the greatest frequency (density).

notes: L lower boundary of the median class, F cumulative frequency before it, f its frequency, w its width.

back: Symmetric: mean = median = mode. Positive skew: mode < median < mean. Negative skew: mean < median < mode.
Extreme values or skew: median. Qualitative data: mode. Further calculations, all values used: mean.
Find each group's total (n × mean), add the totals and divide by the total number; do not average the means.
Grouping loses the actual values; each is assumed to sit at its class midpoint.
